Donna Fiala will be missed deeply by all of Collier County. Her leadership can be felt and seen all over Marco  Island, East Naples and elsewhere about the county. I never met a leader who truly had their finger on the pulse of their constituency quite like she did. Her initiatives were motivated by an unapologetic love for the community she played such a critical role in growing. There will never be another like her. The county, her constituents and our family mourn the loss of a legacy leader

Great time this morning in Pinellas County rolling out my Insurer Scorecard, my plan to boost transparency and lower insurance costs for Floridians. 

Florida families need relief from sky-high property insurance rates. You deserve to know what insurance costs and how well it performs before you buy. 

As Governor, I will fight to put you the consumer in control.

Had a great time with Sheriff Grady Judd, and Representatives Jennifer Canady and Hilary Holley at Reececliff Family Diner. 

Thank you to all the patriots who packed the house and brought the energy this morning. 

We can't wait to be back in Imperial Polk County!
